artworks.title: The Virgin Crowned by Two Angels
artworks.medium: white line woodcut on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a woman holding a child. The woman has a serene expression, long flowing hair, and is wearing a flowing robe. The child is close to her chest. Above her head is a halo, a crown of stars, and two floating angels. The background has swirling lines with a small plant on the left. The scene is rendered in a monochromatic color scheme with intricate details.

artworks.title: Three Breton Women with Infants
artworks.medium: woodcut printed in red-brown on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image shows four figures standing on a rocky shore near the water. The figures are wearing long dresses and head coverings, with simplified, abstract shapes. The monochromatic color scheme emphasizes brown shades. The landscape includes stylized water and rocks in the background. The style resembles that of Paul Gauguin.

artworks.title: Michel Larcher
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a man's upper body in a three-quarter view. The man has distinct facial features including a slight smile, a Roman nose, and a neatly trimmed mustache. He has shoulder-length wavy hair with a central parting and is wearing a dark textured garment with intricate detailing, a wide collar, and a tassel tie. The portrait is surrounded by a patterned frame with text below indicating a name and title. Fine horizontal lines fill the background and the year "1647" is inscribed at the top left corner of the frame.

artworks.title: Stephanus Paschinus
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.1 × 9.4 cm (5 15/16 × 3 11/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait displaying the upper body of an elderly man looking straight ahead but slightly to the left. He has a full beard, mustache, expressive eyebrows, and an intense gaze. His hair is mostly covered by a simple cap, and the visible hair is short and curly. The man is dressed in a dark cloak over a collared garment. The background features a decorative oval frame with floral designs on each side. Latin text is inscribed within the frame around the portrait. Floral motifs are present in each corner of the engraving.

artworks.title: Henry de Bourbon, Prince de Conde
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 15.7 × 10.2 cm (6 3/16 × 4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The engraving shows a bust-length portrait of a man with a beard, mustache, and curly hair. He has a regal expression and is dressed in a detailed garment with a white collar, buttons, a sash, and a star-shaped cross. The background features foliage designs, text, a decorative border, and French text below the portrait.

artworks.title: David Chabodius
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body in an oval frame. He faces slightly right with his head turned forward, displaying sharp facial features, a beard, and a mustache. He wears a formal garment with detailed stitching and decorative buttons. The frame has scrollwork and inscriptions, including a coat of arms with a tower and tree. The background has textured engravings or etchings.

artworks.title: Cichla, Aenea
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a fish. The fish is portrayed in a lateral view, with detailed scales, fins, eye, and gills. The drawing features the fish's texture and pattern, with accompanying text indicating the species name "CICHLA. AENEA" and the artist "C.A. Lesueur deli."

artworks.title: Le General Comte Sebastiani
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man facing forward with a slight left gaze. He has a rounded face, gentle expressions, short curly hair, and is wearing a dark cravat, a collared shirt, and a vest or jacket. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Ames solitaires
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is an image of a promotional advertisement for a publication. The artwork is rendered in sepia tones with swirling lines forming partial outlines of figures or objects. Text announces the publication "La Revue Blanche" starting on January 1, 1894, alongside a list of names. The design gives a vintage and historic ambiance reminiscent of the late 19th century.

artworks.title: Lisez la revue blanche;  Un nuit d'Avril Ceos, L'image
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description:
The image features two figures. On the left, a woman is seated with her upper body visible. Her facial features are not clear, and her hair is styled with a possible hat or headpiece. She wears patterned clothing and holds a sheet of paper. To her left is a light source.

On the right, another figure is seated or kneeling with ambiguous facial features. They wear a flowy garment and appear contemplative.

The scene includes text, with prominent phrases like "Une nuit d'avril" and "L'image." The background is dark with light patterning, suggesting an artistic and literary atmosphere.

artworks.title: Banks of the Marne (Bord de la Marne)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene with a serene atmosphere. The composition includes trees, a horizon line blending into the sky, and vegetation. The brushstrokes are gentle and fluid, and the color palette is primarily gray. The scene conveys a sense of depth and tranquility.

artworks.title: Banks of the Marne (Bord de la Marne)
artworks.medium: drypoint and (etching?) on light green paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a figure seated by a body of water surrounded by bushes. Tall, slender trees are seen in the distance with swirling lines suggesting movement in their leaves. The horizon is low, with rolling hills fading into the sky. The etching features detailed lines creating texture and movement. The color palette is monochromatic, with black shades on a cream background, typical of a pen-like etching technique.

artworks.title: Head of an Old Man (Etude de tete)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a detailed line drawing of an elderly man in profile. He is seated upright and facing to the right. His features include deep-set eyes, a long nose, and a full beard that covers his chin and extends down his chest. He has a lined forehead and is bald with a few hairs above his ears. The man has a thoughtful expression and the lines accentuate the natural creases of his skin. He appears to be wearing a garment, indicated by simple lines around his neck. There is no jewelry or objects in the drawing, and the background is blank.

artworks.title: Egg-sellers, 1st plate (Les marchandes d'oeufs)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals seated close to each other. They are framed from about the knees up, with their hands resting on their laps. The person on the left has a soft, rounded facial structure and wears a headscarf. The person on the right tilts their head slightly downwards and to the side. Both individuals wear voluminous cloaks. Between them, there is a large basket with a braided handle on a flat surface. The background consists of simple, crosshatched lines.

artworks.title: Storm (Un orage)
artworks.medium: drypoint and (etching?) on light green paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape scene with a low horizon line, a vast sky with dramatic cloud formations, clumps of vegetation near the water's edge, and rain streaks across the sky and land. The etching technique is used to create intricate lines for movement and volume. The color palette is monochromatic with various shades of gray, enhancing the atmospheric mood and contrast between land, water, and sky. Light and shadow add depth and dimension to the work.

artworks.title: Storm (Un orage)
artworks.medium: drypoint and (etching?) on light green paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a body of water, vegetation near the water's edge, cloudy skies, and distant land. The brushstrokes create a textured effect, with a monochromatic color scheme of varying shades of gray.

artworks.title: Willows (Les saules)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a close, slightly elevated view of trees and landscape. The horizon is low in the composition, with the land sloping away. The artwork features precise lines and strokes creating texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, using black and beige. Trees are detailed with branches and trunks close to the viewer, with a faint outline of a distant landscape and sky beyond.

artworks.title: Hill with Bushes (La butte aux brousailles)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from a slightly elevated perspective, looking across a rugged terrain. Two tall trees stand to the right, with textured trunks. The ground is undulating with marked lines indicating movement. The horizon is subtly visible with delicate lines. The artwork features fine engravings blending with bold strokes, creating a sketch-like quality. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black against a pale background, accentuating the intricate line work.

artworks.title: Chickweed Merchant (Marchand de mouron)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a crouched position holding stems or branches with a basket on their back. The person has a beard and a cap, wears loose, tattered clothing, and is barefoot. The background is minimalistic with rough lines indicating the ground. A signature is visible in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Banks of the Saint-Pre (Rive du Saint-Pre)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with tall trees and vegetation. The brushstrokes are intricate, with fine cross-hatching creating texture. The color palette is monochromatic in earthy sepia tones. The composition includes a small water body or marsh with dense growth of trees and bushes extending into the distance.

artworks.title: Banks of the Saint-Pre (Rive du Saint-Pre)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This image depicts tall trees from an eye-level perspective, with the horizon subtly suggested by the landscape's elevation. The illustration shows intricate etching techniques, with various line patterns creating texture and depth, especially in the depiction of leaves and foliage. The color palette is monochrome, using grays and blacks to convey contrast and depth. The background is softly blurred, suggesting a serene grove extending into the distance.

artworks.title: Edge of a Wood (Lisiere de bois)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a view from within a densely wooded area looking towards an opening in the distance. The horizon is high, marked by the light sky seen through the dense foliage, forming a natural archway effect with trees on each side. The etching technique includes intricate cross-hatching visible in the texture of the leaves and tree trunks. The color palette is monochromatic, using various shades of black and grey to accentuate the contrast between the dark trees and light sky. The composition narrows from the dark, textured foreground to a lighter area in the middle, opening up to a brighter expanse in the distance.

artworks.title: Banks of the Venelle (Bord de la Venelle)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view across a river towards hills covered in trees. The horizon is high, blending into the sky above the foliage. The artwork is an etching with fine lines depicting textures such as water, banks, and trees. There is a figure by the riverbank. The color palette is monochromatic with soft grays. The composition uses shading and open spaces to emphasize the natural setting.

artworks.title: Fagot-cutter (Le coupeur de fagots)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is an image of a person using a sickle to harvest. The person is leaning forward, focusing on cutting something from a low surface. They are wearing a hat and simple clothing appropriate for manual labor. The drawing uses strong lines and hatching for texture and depth, especially on the clothing and body. The background includes a tree trunk and some vague landscape details, indicating a rural setting.
